unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 3 - Play with Persuasion - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Three pictures held all term: flag (claim), magnifier (prove), megaphone (sell). Weeks 1-5 final piece: a published persuasive text on an issue from The Last Bear.

lessons.title: Hook, Line and Sinker
lessons.focus: Write and battle five kinds of opening hook. Critical feature: a hook makes the reader need the next sentence. Retrieves: Week 1 position statements.

lessons.title: The Persuader's Toolkit
lessons.focus: Use rhetorical questions, the rule of three, repetition and we-words on purpose. Critical feature: a device earns its place only if it moves the reader. Retrieves: Week 2 emotive words.

lessons.title: A Letter from Bear
lessons.focus: Write a persuasive letter in role as a polar bear, using imagery. Critical feature: the writer's point of view decides what the reader feels. Retrieves: Term 3 poetry imagery.

lessons.title: Campaign Creators
lessons.focus: Design a campaign poster: slogan, picture, fact and call to action. Critical feature: words and picture work together on one message. Fun activity: draw and create.
